scope: One-agent self-review of all eight contact sheets (126 artifact captures + 21 guide captures); six full-size inspections. Not an independent reviewer, human recognition test, continuous animation review or timing sample.

findings.measured: Look V2 ON min 6.2448:1, zero scan failures; OFF min 1.6214:1, 27 flagged text nodes per width (81 across all three widths). The scan includes rendered below-fold content, so the smallest ratio is not necessarily in the visible screenshot.
findings.attribution: Legacy-look card text meets a pale gradient; no claim of pixel contrast at every location.
findings.next: Adjust A-owned legacy-look card text/backplate and verify the same three widths on a future artifact.

findings.measured: Six enemy-plate overlaps across four of six ready-scene captures: Button Guard at 1280 in both looks; Button Guard and Sock Skipper at 1024 in both looks. Zero in the two 1440 captures.
findings.attribution: The A-owned fallback strip uses a fixed offset inside the battle region without reserving renderer plate space.
findings.next: Reserve space for the fallback outside the arena; verify ready-scene rectangles. B owns its separate rendering integration.

findings.measured: In-game Field guide still labels Cozy, Scald, Tangle, Steep, Scented, Rattled and Drowsy, including old Tangle/Rattled rules and cap values. The Companions glossary and standalone V5 guide use the eight V5 display names.
findings.attribution: Pages.tsx Codex reads R.STATUSES and statusDescriptionV4 with only a v4 prop; it has no skillsV5 path.
findings.next: Add an A-owned skillsV5-gated Codex vocabulary/description path. Current playtest instructions point to the correct glossary; source remains unchanged.

findings.measured: All six night-route captures have screen=prepare and visibly show Prepare. Current settled route-map screenshot coverage is NOT VERIFIED, despite 126 retained captures.
findings.attribution: The prepared practice state survives the imported save; Night route resolves to the pending Prepare screen. The harness asserted readiness, not the requested map identity.
findings.next: Future route fixture must clear the pending tutorial and assert screen identity. No repeated screenshot pack or replacement of these samples.

findings.measured: Home/Companions captures include Preparing miniatures. The battle capture explicitly waits for scene readiness; the meta captures do not wait for miniature readiness.
findings.attribution: These are real sampled transitions, not proof of a persistent missing model.
findings.next: Use a future settled-miniature check if assessing appearance or loading, separate from this retained pack.

positiveObservations: Default Look V2 measured minimum contrast 6.2448:1; all captured pages report zero horizontal overflow.
Prepare exposes shapes and crew hints; the labelled reaction Result names Brioche triggering Rupture twice.
Static V5 and refreshed A5 guide checks report no remote requests or errors; minimum contrast 7.3332:1 and 7.2106:1 respectively.
Public captures exclude review controls; the separate actual dev=1 load includes them.
limitations: Image counts establish completeness of files, not coverage of every intended screen or every state.
Six combat captures are ready scenes, not full-battle collision coverage.
Guide contact sheets show selected viewports; parsed guide content checks cover all eight keywords and twelve kits.
No production source, acceptance seed, threshold or sample changed during this review.
